missing mask.human_intent: These tasks are grouped because Eric expects them to be solved by recovering information hidden or missing behind a mask, not because they share one exact geometry or one exact operation.
missing mask.parent_idea: A visible region is blocking or replacing information, and the solution must recover what should be there.

subfamilies.name: large_multicolor_missing_region
subfamilies.description: Large multicolored arrays where part of the array is missing or covered and must be reconstructed from the surrounding pattern.

subfamilies.name: covered_middle_of_shapes
subfamilies.description: Two or three shapes appear inside the array and something covers the middle; the hidden middle must be recovered from the visible shapes.

missing mask.learning_rule: Do not require every task in the parent group to share the same low-level geometry. Learn what the close subfamily members share, what differs in the other subfamily, and then search for the higher-level concept that connects the subfamilies.
